messages.snippet: Alice, Following IC approval, attached is our proposed term sheet: £8m at £24m pre (£32m post), 25.0
messages.subject: Larkmoor Series A - term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice,

Following IC approval, attached is our proposed term sheet: £8m at £24m pre (£32m post), 25.0% on a fully diluted basis, 1x non-participating preference, one Investor Director, broad-based weighted average anti-dilution. We'd want exclusivity to 30 September and the usual fee cap of £35k.

Keen to sign quickly and target completion mid-September.

Geraldine
Ardent Ventures LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Alice, Marcus,

The term sheet is broadly market for a Series A of this size. Two points to push on: (1) confirm the option pool top-up to 12% sits pre-money (it does as drafted, which is in your favour to flag); (2) the fee cap is fine. Otherwise I'd suggest we accept. Marked-up term sheet attached for your records.

Happy to call.
